scope: same-day structural save equality, not a second native capture or a growth horizon
sql: SELECT count(*) AS paired, sum(a.ca<>b.ca) AS changed_ca, sum(a.pa<>b.pa) AS changed_pa, sum(a.candidate<>b.candidate) AS changed_saved_progression_factor, sum(a.raw_attrs<>b.raw_attrs) AS changed_raw_attribute_vector FROM player a JOIN player b USING(uid,birth) WHERE a.tag=? AND b.tag=?
